title: YieldVault Webhook Registration Request
description: Body of POST /admin/webhooks. Source of truth: WebhookRegisterSchema in backend/src/middleware/validate.ts.

url.description: http:// or https:// endpoint that will receive deliveries.

eventTypes.description: Event types to subscribe to. Defaults to all known event types when omitted.

enabled.description: Whether the endpoint is active. New endpoints also require successful challenge verification before real events are dispatched.

secret.description: Shared secret used to compute the HMAC-SHA256 X-YieldVault-Signature header.
